memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent in ADLs, walks to shop, uses public transport. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (negative). falls: none in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds. medicines: 7 regular (propranolol, sumatriptan, topiramate, naproxen, mebeverine, ispaghula husk, loperamide) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria. mood: reports occasional irritability, denies depression. carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby. goals: "I want to keep running my shop without pain interruptions."
